action_items.text: The Project Manager instructed the User Interface Designer to construct the prototype.
The Project Manager instructed the Industrial Designer to construct the prototype.
The User Interface Designer will work on the interface.
The Industrial Designer will work on the look and feel of the device.
The Marketing Expert will prepare a prototype evaluation.

decisions.text: The remote will feature a spongy material.
The fruits and vegetables trend will be incorporated into the design by including fruit colors along with the company colors.
The remote will feature a changeable outer casing.
